contributor to MP (1883-6)

She was the author of Charles Lowder and Letters and Memorials of Richard Chenevix Trench, sister of Thomas R. F. Cooke Trench, and a cousin of Maria (Trench) Wilson. Her letters to Bullock (1894-6) in the Bodleian Library are written from Lisanskea, Blackrock, Dublin. [T.R.F. Cooke Trench, A Memoir of the Trench Family 1897; her tombstone Millicent church web]
